subject: Reserved Pool TPS addendum + GPU top-up for CloudDent renewal
messages:
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Chen <emily@clouddent.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal planning — reserved pool TPS addendum and GPU top-up

Hi Emily —

Thanks again for the call today. As discussed, CloudDent’s usage profile has trended up 42% QoQ and your ops team expects peak inference bursts for nightly batch jobs plus steady online traffic during business hours. To keep latency predictable for your deploys while remaining cost-efficient, we recommend the following changes to the Dedicated reservation at renewal: 

- Add 8x A100-equivalent GPUs to your reserved pool (bringing the total to 24 GPUs).
- Contract a tokens-per-second (TPS) assurance of 18,000 tokens/sec for the reserved pool with a burst policy up to 27,000 tokens/sec for scheduled jobs (subject to pre-booked burst windows).
- SLO target: 99.5% TPS availability per month; P95 response latency <= 600ms on the primary inference model under normal load.

I’ve attached a draft addendum and a simple capacity projection for your finance review. Key operational notes: we’ll route overflow to compatible lower-cost model variants automatically and surface incidents to your on-call through PagerDuty. For outages exceeding the SLO, the addendum includes credits capped to the monthly reservation fee (we can iterate on exact language).

Could you confirm whether the burst windows align with your current nightly batch (typically 02:00–04:00 PT)? Once you confirm, Marissa and I will produce a redline-ready addendum to attach to the renewal paperwork.

Best,
Ava Chen
Account Executive — Enterprise
Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0142

Attachments: RD-CLD-2026-045_addendum_draft_v1.docx (draft addendum), capacity_projection_clouddent.csv (projected tokens/day)

From: Emily Chen <emily@clouddent.ai>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: CloudDent Procurement <procurement@clouddent.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal planning — reserved pool TPS addendum and GPU top-up

Thanks, Ava — this looks in line with what we discussed. A couple of quick clarifications before we escalate to procurement: 

1) The 18k TPS: is that an aggregate across the pool or per-GPU? We need to map that to our user-level throughput and approximate concurrent requests.
2) What is the billing delta (monthly committed fee) for the +8 GPUs and the TPS assurance? Can you provide a line-item estimate we can send to finance?
3) For incident handling, can you share the playbook for degraded TPS (e.g., degraded to 50% capacity) and the expected escalation timeline?

If those answers look good, procurement will ask for the addendum redline and a DocuSign-ready file. We aim to finalize terms by end of next week.

—Emily
Emily Chen
Head of ML Platform, CloudDent
emily@clouddent.ai | +1 (650) 555-0920

(added procurement as requested)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 10:45:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Renewal planning — pricing and draft addendum notes

Ava / Neha — forwarding Emily’s questions. Quick notes below we should include in the redline: 

- TPS definition: tokens/sec is aggregate across the reserved pool; we’ll include mapping guidance in the addendum (example conversion: ~140 tokens/request for CloudDent’s median prompt -> ~130 concurrent reqs at 18k TPS).
- Cost delta (rough): +8x A100-equivalent reserved GPUs = $62,000/month committed (example include hardware amortization, sustained occupancy). TPS assurance add-on (service fee covering capacity reservation and SLO credits) = $9,000/month. Total incremental = ~$71,000/month. Will provide official quote in renewal schedule.
- Incident playbook: include an operational appendix: automated reroute to warm fallback variant within 30s; on-call alert at 5 mins; escalation to SRE lead at 30 mins; if sustained <80% TPS for >4 hours, automatic credit remediation begins per SLA table.

I attached the draft addendum and a capacity projection used to build the numbers. I’ll prepare the DocuSign package once Ava confirms final wording.

Marissa Cole
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: RD-CLD-2026-045_addendum_draft_v1.docx, capacity_projection_clouddent.csv

From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Chen <emily@clouddent.ai>, CloudDent Procurement <procurement@clouddent.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Addendum redline for signature (includes SLO table and credits)

Emily / Procurement —

Attached is the redline-ready addendum: key pieces automated into the body for DocuSign. Excerpts below for quick review before you escalate to legal: 

- Definition: Tokens-per-second ("TPS") means the aggregate number of model-generated tokens served from the reserved pool per second, measured at the Redwood edge prior to any client-side batching.
- Commitment: Customer reserves an allocation equal to 18,000 TPS with a contractual right to pre-book bursts up to 27,000 TPS for specified windows (window booking at least 48 hours in advance).
- SLOs and credits: Monthly TPS availability target = 99.5%. Failure to meet monthly availability triggers service credits as follows: 99.0–99.5% = 5% of monthly reservation fee; 98.0–99.0% = 12% credit; <98.0% = 25% credit (credits capped at monthly reservation value).
- Fallback & routing: Redwood will automatically route requests to an approved fallback model variant when pool capacity is constrained. Fallback latency targets are included (P95 <= 1.8s).
- Incident remediation: Automatic warm-up and pre-warm for scheduled burst windows, on-call paging, and a post-incident report within 3 business days.

I also included Marissa’s cost delta in the schedule. If this covers your questions, we’ll bundle the addendum into the renewal SOW and send a DocuSign link.

DocuSign (preview): https://www.docusign.com/embedded-sign/abcdef123456
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/67890

Thanks — please reply with any remaining redlines. If none, Emily feel free to sign and we’ll arrange an onboarding call for the expanded pool next week.

Best,
Ava

Attachment: RD-CLD-2026-045_addendum_draft_v1.docx

From: Emily Chen <emily@clouddent.ai>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: CloudDent Procurement <procurement@clouddent.ai>
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Addendum redline for signature (includes SLO table and credits)

Thanks — looks good. Procurement will finish legal review this afternoon. I’m signing the DocuSign now and booking the standard burst windows for 02:00–04:00 PT on weekdays. Please confirm the onboarding call slot for Friday 09:00 PT.

—Emily
